defects.test_name: Error Handling and Edge Cases > [EC-10] migrator skips existing migrations on repeat runs
defects.rationale: Test queries __drizzle_migrations table which substrate verification confirms does not exist.

upstream_cause.evidence: bootstrap_check 'drizzle-migrations-tracking-table' did not observe expected post-condition: SQL `SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name='__drizzle_migrations'` returned no rows.
